sections.title: Create Your Party
blocks: Choose up to 4 champions.
Each character has different stats and skills.
A balanced party is essential for survival.
You can reincarnate a champion for better stats.

sections.title: Party Leader
blocks: The selected character is the leader.
They represent the party in some interactions.
Change the leader depending on the situation.

sections.title: Movement and Interaction
blocks: Movement is grid-based, one step at a time.
Turn left or right to change direction.
Click on objects and walls to interact.
Carefully explore every area.

sections.title: Real-Time Combat
blocks: Combat happens in real time.
Each character can attack using their hands.
Actions consume stamina.
Positioning is key to survival.

sections.title: Progression
blocks: Skills improve through use.
Fighting, casting, and actions increase abilities.
There is no traditional leveling system.

sections.title: Magic
blocks: Spells are created using runes.
Combine power, element, and form.
Stronger spells consume more mana.
Experiment to discover new effects.

sections.title: Inventory
blocks: Each character has their own inventory.
Carried weight affects performance.
Organize items to stay efficient.
Equip weapons and armor to improve survival.

sections.title: Exploration
blocks: Look for hidden buttons and secret paths.
Observe walls and floors carefully.
Solve puzzles to progress.
Try different actions if you are stuck.
